material.notes: AUDIT 38 (3): held at matched, reason corrected. The note says Flutter's rest inactive track (d9d0e4, dark 413b4f) is the fromSeed secondary-container; it is not: in the same Flutter scheme segmentedbutton-rest paints secondary-container e8def8 (dark 4a4458). What the refs do show is that Flutter's own single Slider (slider-rest) paints the inactive track e6e0e9 (dark 36343a), equal to ours and to Material Web, so the M3 token argument (surface-container-highest) is valid and the d9d0e4 / 413b4f of RangeSlider is a Flutter RangeSlider quirk, not the palette. Recorded deviation stands with this evidence. | ROUND 78 (n): Audit 37 gap recorded, not changed: rest inactive track e6e0e9 (M3 spec, `md.comp.slider.inactive.track.color` = surface-container-highest, and equal to the Material Web ref ref/material slider-labeled-rest e6e0e9 exactly) against Flutter d9d0e4 (Flutter paints secondary-container of its fromSeed palette; the baseline secondary-container is e8def8, so Flutter's value is also the accepted palette difference). Thumb 20, track 4 as before. Spec value kept; flutter-compare-n.md. | AUDIT 37 (round 77 m check, reproduced with an own comparer): held: thumb flat 19 x 18 (Flutter 18 to 19 x 18), inactive track 4 high, disabled thumb a9a3aa against a8a3aa, disabled inactive track e3dde4 against e2dce4 (dark 2d2b31 against 2e2b31). Downgraded to review: (1) the rest inactive track is e6e0e9 against Flutter's d9d0e4 (dark 36343b against 413b4f), 13 and 11 levels; e6e0e9 is surface-container-highest as Material Web draws it, M3 secondary-container would be e8def8, neither equals the ref, and the note records only the thickness (4 against 4). Record the colour as a deviation (Material Web evidence) or move the track to the Flutter value, then raise again. | ROUND 77 (m, compared to Flutter, docs/ui/looks/flutter-compare-m.md): RangeSlider rest, focus and disabled refs: thumb 20 (20), inactive track 4 (4), disabled thumb a9a3aa against a8a3aa. Recorded deviations: active track 4 against Flutter 6, state layer 40 against 48 (M3 spec kept), focus halo on both handles against the first only, disabled active track at M3's 38 % on-surface against Flutter's lighter b5b0b7.
gaps: Only Material draws round handles (material_slider); Neper, Windows, Linux and Cupertino draw the Neper bar handles because the platform slider branches skip a two-handle slider (Cupertino and Linux have no range slider of their own)
The Neper focus ring boxes the whole track; no value pill for a range
